_comment: Single owner of the external revision pins consumed by the build, the container image and CI. brainrust.git_sha is a PUBLISHED commit (tag v0.3.8): CI fetches it by SHA, so it must be reachable from a remote ref. bin/BRAINRUST_RELEASE.json is a build ARTIFACT that records the binaries actually installed on this host and is never a CI input; a `source: worktree` artifact legitimately runs ahead of this pin. Keep Dockerfile ARG defaults in lockstep through `make verify-release-pin`.
